query_construction: deterministic TF-IDF salient-term extraction over the full frozen facts-only text: segment by sentence/paragraph, remove procedural-report boilerplate, score unigrams by segment TF-IDF with a mild within-document frequency factor, retain section/article cues, and select at most 32 unique terms
legacy_query_construction: legacy-first-32-terms-v1 (retained only to reproduce the Week 9 final regression)
redundancy_rule: select at most one chunk per source_id
ordering: descending BM25 score; retain original retrieval rank as deterministic tie-breaker
rationale: A small, source-diverse evidence set is easier to inspect and reduces adjacent-passage duplication without adding a learned reranker. The salient-term query builder was adopted after the final fixed-test regression showed no degradation on six pre-specified controls and one improvement.
